newsitem.title: UK: LPC - IBJ launches syndication of Slovakia loan.
newsitem.headline: LPC - IBJ launches syndication of Slovakia loan.

text.p: LONDON July 25 (LPC) - Lead arranger IBJ today launched syndication of a $120 million multicurrency term loan for the Republic of Slovakia, which is Slovakia's first sovereign Euroloan. The transaction, which will be administered by the Ministry of Finance, is also Slovakia's longest-dated loan at seven years.

The deal, which has been underwritten by joint arrangers Bayerische Landesbank, Credit Lyonnais, Kredietbank and Sanwa, has been launched to co-arrangers, which are being asked to contribute $10 million each.

The deal is priced at 42.5 bps over LIBOR for years one to three, 50 bps for years four and five, 60 bps for six and seven and 75 bps for years eight to 10. The deal includes an extension option of a further three years at lender's discretion, giving a maximum maturity of 10 years.

As the deal sets a benchmark with pricing and tenor, arranger IBJ conducted extensive pre-marketing prior to launch, which revealed that appetite for seven-year Slovakian risk was finite, and prompted the conclusion that "we had to price the back end of the deal up to make it attractive".

The transaction, which will finance the preparation and construction of highways and border crossings, originally started life as a project financing, but turned into a sovereign deal due to the complexity of the proposed deal structure. The end user will be the Slovak State Fund for Road Administration. For further details go to LOANS LPC Newsroom 44-171-542-4048
